title: Seed exposure and normalization sensitivity in network-propagation drug ranking by gene-set averaging: an adrenocortical carcinoma audit with breast-cancer and melanoma comparisons
description: Code, protocols, derived data and audit records for a reproducible analysis of seed exposure, topology and normalization sensitivity in gene-set-averaged drug ranking. Code is licensed under MIT. Author-generated derived data and documentation are licensed under CC BY 4.0 within the scope defined in DATA_LICENSE.md. Third-party raw data are excluded and remain subject to their source terms.
